status: Architect internal representation clarification under approved S2; no runtime or new authority

timer.qualification: Exactly one owner-compatible current timer for requested clock; all actual source event rows referenced by its authentic provenance are also included. B may use case timer; A/C/D must resolve canonical infraction-owned timer rather than a convenience duplicate.

track.qualification: A only. Include actual supporting tempestividade row and immutable event/audit receipt for a360 extension; for180 include independent authorized track disposition. No absent criterion=>180, date-difference=>track, or mere boolean=>authentic extension.

movement.qualification: C only: actual approved reset event and applicable complete operative movement-policy parameter, sourceRefs and receipt prove that event sets current timer start. Include all matching event/audit records, never pick nearest timestamp.
movement.policyProvenance: Complete independently qualified operative policy dependency receipt is mandatory. Include exact ops.parameter row if that is the actual existing policy source; otherwise the admitted existing canonical policy source/version is bound by a qualified dependency receipt. This adds no new parameter key, writer or policy value. Descriptive/unqualified policy remains unavailable.

interruption.qualification: D only, two source-backed alternatives. RESET: actual authorized interruption event and qualified complete applicable interruption policy. ORIGINAL: independently verified practice/cessation start and current timer/clock provenance plus complete current-source/history coverage proving no inferred or unresolved reset; no complete global interruption list required merely to retain proven original start. Missing/ambiguous current disposition503; never absent event=>original.
interruption.policyProvenance: Required for actual RESET branch only: complete independently qualified applicable interruption policy, bound through actual existing parameter+activation or admitted closed policy dependency receipt. ORIGINAL branch instead requires independent original-start disposition and complete current-source/no-inferred-reset provenance; it does not require an invented global list.
interruption.eventAlternative: Qualified current interruption event OR independently verified original-start receipt, as exact kindCardinalities specifies; initial start never requires invented event.

parameter.qualification: Selected effective parameter row and authenticated version activation receipt, including exact value object. Case association/agency precedence is verified independently in current caller Tx; a tenant-wide activation is not case-read authority.

incident.qualification: One authoritative alert incident_ref resolves unique same-tenant incident; all populated case/clock links agree. Exact independently trusted operational receipt/audit lineage binds current incident+alert rows. No role/action inferred from label.

legacy.qualification: Internal legacy resolver validates latest version-bound disposition and actual referenced sources. qualified_unassigned requires authentic admission+distribution source/history/audit, exact current pool relation, no active assignment and independently admitted disposition. preserve_assigned requires actual assignment/ref; hold requires preserved reason and authentic authorization. No new authoritative historical audit action is invented.

digestAlgorithm: sha256 UTF-8 canonical compact JSON; prefix sha256:; no BOM/trailing newline
canonicalObjectKeyOrder: Recursive manual key serialization in ECMAScript default UTF-16 code-unit sort; do not stringify a rebuilt object whose integer-like property enumeration may reorder keys
timestamps: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ via SQL microsecond text, never JS Date truncation
integers: Safe JSON integers only, except audit event_id lossless decimal string
nulls: Every declared projection key present. SQL NULL=>JSON null; missing key rejects. Missing row is unavailable, never null row/NA. SQL column absent from table is not added.
jsonb: Object value preserved; recursive canonical keys; arrays preserve order. Generic JSON string ladder rejected. Finite safe numeric JSON only; source requiring greater precision unavailable unless separately specified.
rowDigest: SHA256 canonical {sourceRef,table,fields}; sourceRefs are internal identities, not public authority
requestDigest: contentRevision = SHA256 canonical source envelope containing actual projected rows + qualified dependency receipt digests, excluding asOf so asOf is not a source revision
receiptDigest: SHA256 canonical receipt core, independent verified origin outside core; never include own digest
trust: Receipt bytes/digest/signature field alone never qualify. Reader must independently admit trusted operational source or exact immutable audit lineage. Controlled test adapter holds precomputed immutable receipts; compare actual current SQL row digest bindings. Never construct receipt from request.contentRevision.
allowedCaseNull: parameter receipt only may have caseId=null, for actual selected tenant/agency/surface parameter activation; envelope request caseId remains actual case and current scope/precedence separately checked. All other receipts bind exact caseId.
exclusions: No sourceRefs or payload in public sourceVersions

encodingOnlyVector.note: ASCII keys: Python sort_keys equals ECMAScript code-unit order for this vector only. Empty rows deliberately invalid source; encoding vector cannot qualify.

numberEncoding: ECMAScript JSON.stringify finite numeric serialization; integer SQL columns safe integer; audit event_id decimal string. JSONB numeric must round-trip without precision loss. Do not replace decimals with approximate rounding.
policySourceRule: Canonical policySources is sorted unique by sourceRef, binding exact whole-document byte digest. Fixed existing sources only; actual verified decisionRef required. Hash alone cannot qualify incomplete text. Actual C reset or D interruption requires independently admitted complete applicable policy. Proven D ORIGINAL start requires independent original-start/current-source/no-inferred-reset disposition, not a global closed interruption list. Existing parameter alternative binds actual selected row/version, no new key. Missing or ambiguous branch/source503.

kindCardinalities.parameter: Exactly one ops.parameter row per request/activation receipt, actual selected key/version. No unrelated parameter or case row; request still actual caseId, scope verified separately. Multiple ladders produce separate parameter qualification requests and receipt dependencies.
kindCardinalities.timer: Exactly one case, one linked AIT, one linked infraction, one requested applicable clock and exactly one owner-compatible current timer. A/C/D require infraction_timer; B case-owned rait_deadline only with qualified instance source. Include all and only actual event/audit support rows named in admitted receipt; missing named row rejects.
kindCardinalities.track: Exactly one case/AIT/infraction/A-clock/current T-DEC timer. Exactly one current tempestividade record if360; include every actual extension-event/audit record named by admitted track proof. For180 verified independent track receipt, no implicit absence assertion; optional criterion if consumed must be bound.
kindCardinalities.movement: Exactly one case/infraction/C-clock/current T-PAR-3A timer. Exactly one resolved current reset event from case_event OR infraction_event (not both competing). Every additional support/audit record named by its admitted proof included. Exactly one operative policy: selected actual parameter row plus activation receipt OR closed canonical policy dependency receipt with exact policySources. No unresolved competing newer reset event may be ignored.
kindCardinalities.interruption: Exactly one case/infraction/D-clock/current T-PRESC-5A timer. RESET branch: one qualified actual legal interruption event plus complete applicable operative policy; all named support rows included. ORIGINAL branch: verified practice/cessation source (include consumed AIT), independent original-start disposition and complete authoritative current timer/history/source coverage proving no unresolved or inferred reset; no fabricated event/list. Include every event/audit row covered by source receipt and validate current coverage/parent/source revisions in caller Tx. Missing record alone is not no-reset proof. Any contradictory/unknown current source503.
kindCardinalities.incident: Exactly one case, one requested clock, one authoritative current operational-prescription alert ref and one unique same-tenant incident. Multiple equivalent alert records cannot be silently collapsed: independently qualified receipt must identify authoritative current alert; otherwise ambiguous. All populated links must agree. No cause/outcome columns consumed.
kindCardinalities.legacy: Exactly one current case, one latest qualification revision for locked current observed_version, one reviewer auth.users identity. Qualified_unassigned: exact admission/distribution events and their actual available immutable audit lineage; exact active case_pool_scope/pool source; complete current active-assignment query must establish unassigned and be independently covered by disposition receipt, not missing row alone. preserve_assigned: one current active assignment/ref with compatible pool. hold: no invented missing proofs but nonempty reason and independent authorization. Include all/only referenced support rows; contradictory newer disposition/revision/source or assignments409.

optionalRows: Only supporting event/audit/parameter/parent rows actually consumed or explicitly bound by admitted evidence may be added, with exact rowFields projection; include every such named ref. Extra unrelated rows reject. A request covers one clock or one parameter; aggregate four-clock computation composes four complete requests, not arbitrary missing row subsets.

originalStartBoundary.source: RN-RAIT-113 original practice/cessation; ADR0049 verified start/reset/ceiling; source-freeze D original OR authorized interruption
required: verified original practice/cessation source and canonical current timer/clock alignment
complete authoritative current-source/history coverage bound by exact current parent/timer/source revisions and all consumed event/audit rows
current same-Tx revalidation detects contradictory/unknown reset or changed coverage
originalStartBoundary.not_required: A globally complete interruption list solely to preserve independently proven unchanged original start
forbidden: absence of a reset event alone as proof

legacyPortExtension: Add only legacy to RaitRiskProvenanceRequest.kind in existing owned riskport and reuse existing trusted reader boundary; no other signature/token/path changes. RaitLegacyQualificationService reconstructs and verifies actual SQL source envelope, not opaque authorization_ref. Existing six risk kinds unchanged.

legacyRefBindings.admission_ref: Exact sql:inf.rait_case_event:<uuid> admission transition for same tenant/case, cross-bound to actual same-case INF_RAIT_CASE_ADMIT audit and receipt. Historical imported alternative requires independently verified operational source that explicitly proves admission, not invented action label.
legacyRefBindings.distribution_ref: Exact sql:inf.rait_case_event:<uuid> historical ADMITIDO->DISTRIBUIDO, linked to current pool and authentic historical operational receipt. Fixture explicitly synthetic history, no invented authoritative audit action.
legacyRefBindings.pool_scope_ref: Exact sql:inf.rait_case_pool_scope:<uuid> active same-tenant/case/pool plus actual compatible active pool row; source_ref/authorization_ref independently covered. Existing approved assignment/batch route may be used only if independently qualified with all actual canonical source rows; not a guessed alternate ref.
legacyRefBindings.assignment_ref: sql:inf.rait_assignment:<uuid> mandatory preserve_assigned; active same-tenant/case/pool. qualified_unassigned no active assignment, proven through complete current query/disposition coverage.
legacyRefBindings.authorization_ref: receipt:<lowercase UUID receiptId>, the stable ID of an independently admitted legacy receipt core. Locator equality is never authority. Receipt binds every actual source row including exact qualification authorization_ref/reviewer/currentversion. Receipt ID exists before hashing; receipt digest is computed after full bindings, so no field masking or self-hash cycle.
legacyRefBindings.reviewer_id: Existing auth.users.id, equal authenticated receipt authorization.actorId; qualified historical authorization at observed_at comes from admitted receipt, not invented reviewerrole/current-role guess. Actor deactivation alone does not rewrite historical decision; receipt revocation/inconsistent provenance denies.

legacyStatus: Missing/stale/wrongtenant/contradictory or untrusted qualification -> RAIT.CLAIM_LEGACY_UNVERIFIED409; no candidate detail. Success uses earlier approved source contract, not new replay/state/write permission.
receiptIdentity: receiptId is a lowercase canonical UUID allocated as stable identity before binding/hashing; receipt:<uuid> is internal operational receipt locator. Receipt digest is separately computed and verified; no receipt field is its own digest, and no actual SQL field is masked.
